title: Keto Slovakian Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Slovakian-inspired stew made with pork and served as a comforting keto meal. This recipe combines the rich flavors of traditional Slovakian cuisine with the benefits of a ketogenic diet.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the pork cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the pot and set aside.
Add the sausage to the pot and cook until browned, about 3 minutes.
Add the onion, carrots, celery, and garlic to the pot and cook until the vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth and tomato paste to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the pork to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
